description: THE channel for anything a HUMAN must do, decide or answer (approve, confirm data, classify, check something on site). Not create_todo (that is the agent's own list), not send_team_email or mail/WhatsApp to colleagues. Address the person who must act with `an` (name or user_id, resolved only within this tenant; default: the key owner) — it lands in THAT person's delegation inbox on the website and in the app, counted at the bell. Link it with `bezug` {typ: 'deal'|'project'|…, id: e.g. the DN number} and a short `thema`: an open delegation for the same person + bezug + thema is REUSED (reused: true, new questions appended) instead of creating a second one — so never ask the same thing again, wait for the answer. A deadline (frist_at) follows from importance (≥80: 4 working hours, ≥60: next working morning 09:00; or pass `frist`); unanswered after it the person is reminded once a day (07–19 Zurich) and then it is escalated to the tenant's escalation person. Hand a concise summary and zero or more open questions to the human — from a scheduled Dev-Agent turn OR from an interactive Dev-Agent session. Each question needs text, importance (0-100), and 1-n recommended answers. The questions appear in the user's delegation inbox in CallPilotAI; when answered, this same session is resumed automatically with the answers. NO ids are required: schedule_run_id, runner_id and session_id are only passed in a scheduled turn (from its instruction). Anywhere else — an interactive Dev-Agent session, Claude Desktop, any client — just call it with summary and questions; in a Dev-Agent session the runner supplies runner and session itself, so the answer resumes this session. Use it for decisions the human must take (approve a draft, pick an option), not for chat. For EVERY question also recommend which agent should handle it (recommended_agent_id from list_agents, plus a one-line recommended_agent_reason) — yourself if you can, another agent if it has the rights or the expertise you lack; null only when no agent should act and the human decides alone. The inbox offers the human a one-click hand-over to that agent. Reply drafts to an incoming item: ALWAYS set source {kind: 'email'|'inbound_message', id} on EACH question (questions[].source), also when one delegation holds many drafts — only then does each mail/message carry its draft and /app/inbox count it under 'Entwürfe zur Freigabe'. The result reports linked_sources and unlinked_sources (with reason).

an.description: Who must answer/act: name (e.g. 'Max Mustermann', 'Erika') or user_id from list_tenant_users. Only members of this tenant; ambiguous or unknown names are refused with the member list. Default: the key owner.

an_user_id.description: Same as an, as a user_id.

bezug.description: What it is about, for duplicate detection and the inbox: {typ: deal|project|lead|account|contact|offer|lab_order|todo|email|other, id}. For deals the deal number (e.g. '1000').

id.description: ID of the related record, for deals the deal number

typ.description: Type of the related record, e.g. deal, project, lead, account or other

frist.description: Optional deadline (ISO date-time). Default from importance: ≥80 four working hours, ≥60 next working morning 09:00, below no deadline.

questions.description: Open questions for the human, each with text, importance and recommended answers

depends_on.description: This question waits for another result: delegation_id (from delegate_task) or todo_id. Shown as 'wartet auf …'; an answer resumes the session only once that is done (e.g. approve a mail only after the LinkedIn search came back).

email.description: When the question is whether to send an email draft: the draft itself, structured, instead of packing AN:/BETREFF:/TEXT: into text. Keep text to the decision (e.g. 'Entwurf 1/4 - Erstansprache Dr. X: so senden?'). attachments: ALWAYS set it. [] when nothing goes out (draft_message returns attachments: [] — keep it unless you add files); otherwise EVERY file that goes out, one entry each with its exact file name (plus document_id or path when known) — never a summary like 'voller Satz'. Omitted is NOT 'none': the card then warns the human 'Anhänge nicht angegeben'.

attachments.description: Every file that goes out with the draft; [] when none

name.description: Exact file name of the attachment

path.description: Storage path of the attachment file, when known

size_bytes.description: File size of the attachment in bytes

body.description: Full mail text, with line breaks

to.description: Recipient address(es) of the email draft

id.description: Optional stable ID of the question

importance.description: Importance 0-100; also sets the default deadline

recommendations.description: One or more recommended answers offered to the human

recommended_agent_id.description: Agent (id from list_agents, or its exact name — resolved only within this tenant) that should handle this question after the human answers.

source.description: The incoming item THIS question's reply draft answers: {kind: 'email'|'inbound_message', id}. ALWAYS set it for a reply draft to an incoming item. The item then carries this delegation as its reply draft (triage_draft_delegation_id), only within this tenant. A malformed source creates nothing; an item that is missing or not writable is reported in unlinked_sources with its reason, the delegation is still created.

id.description: ID of the incoming email or inbound message this draft answers

kind.description: Type of the incoming item this draft answers: email or inbound_message

text.description: The question or decision, kept short

session_name.description: Name of the asking Dev-Agent session, resumed with the answers

source.description: The incoming item this is about (e.g. the mail a reply draft answers): {kind: 'email'|'inbound_message', id}. The item then carries this delegation as its reply draft (triage_draft_delegation_id). Checked BEFORE anything is created. For several drafts in one delegation use questions[].source per question instead.

id.description: ID of the incoming email or inbound message

kind.description: Type of the incoming item: email or inbound_message

summary.description: Concise summary for the human of what this is about

thema.description: Short topic key, e.g. 'Daten komplett bestätigen' or 'MaP einstufen'. Same person + bezug + thema while open = the same delegation.

name: delegate_to_user
